To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
futile cycles shift effective equilibria in biochemical pathways and that this is the mechanism by which they regulate the concentrations of intermediary metabolites.

the effective equilibrium constants of intermediates in a biochemical pathway are regulated by futile cycles, and this regulation can be used for ultrasensitivity and super-robust control of intermediary metabolism.

1) the effective equilibrium constant is a key factor in the regulation of metabolic pathways; 2) the effective equilibrium can be regulated via futile cycles; 3) futile cycles can actively shift the effective equilibria by expending energy and thus regulate the sensitivity of the system; 4) futile cycles are also intimately related to concentration fluctuations of intermediary metabolites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of metabolic regulation by futile cycles.
the role of energy in metabolic regulation.
the thermodynamic basis of metabolic control and the thermodynamic and kinetic properties of the control of biochemical pathways by futile cycles.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the function of metabolic futile cycles is to control the effective equilibria of metabolic intermediates, and thereby the sensitivity of metabolic fluxes to changes in metabolite concentrations.
futile cycles are not just metabolic noise, but are involved in the fine-tuning of metabolic regulation and control, and are a key component in the evolution of cellular metabolism.
the futile cycles are a powerful mechanism of metabolic regulation and control.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
metabolic futile cycles are not just a waste of energy, but a means of controlling metabolic processes.

the futile cycle is a general principle of cellular regulation that can be used to control the effective equilibrium constants of intermediary reactions and thereby the fluxes through metabolic pathways.
metabolic futile cycles are involved in metabolic control and that their role is to actively shift effective equilibria in the direction of the futile cycle flux.
The main takeaway from our work is that
futile cycles are a powerful mechanism for metabolic regulation, but they are only effective when they are coupled to a net flow of energy.
futile cycles can be a powerful mechanism to shift effective equilibrium constants and to regulate metabolic fluxes.
futile cycles are not just metabolic wastage, but can play an important role in the regulation of metabolism.
